name: douvi-ios-bridge
description: A local-first Windows workbench for Flutter iOS builds on your own macOS CI.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts
scripts.lint: biome check apps/desktop/src packages/core/src tests scripts --error-on-warnings
scripts.format: biome check --write apps/desktop/src packages/core/src tests scripts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
